N1.s: Ja has omplert els %lld cutlings gratuïts. Continua a Cutling per desbloquejar-lo i el nou quedarà desat.
N1.back: Already you-have filled the 5 cutlings free. Continue in Cutling for to-unlock-it and the new-one will-remain saved.
N1.why: Opens with S3's verb for all used (omplir), without S3's possessive so N2 fits; Siri may speak this with nothing on screen, so "el nou" (the new one) names the item where "aquest" would point at nothing.

N2.s: Ja has omplert els %lld cutlings gratuïts. Obre Cutling i desbloqueja’l per desar-ne més.
N2.back: Already you-have filled the 5 cutlings free. Open Cutling and unlock-it for to-save-of-them more.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; the partitive in "desar-ne més" is how a speaker says save more of them, and ’l can only mean Cutling.

N3.s: Desat. En queda un de gratuït
N3.back: Saved. Of-them remains one of free
N3.why: "En queda un de gratuït" is the spoken partitive for one left; Desat is masculine for the cutling; 29 characters, no closing period, as a capsule takes it.

N4.why: "Ja tens" as in K1 and "de" as in S29, so the full count reads the same everywhere; 30 characters with single-digit numbers.

N5.s: %lld de %lld gratuïts. Desbloqueja i es desarà
N5.back: 5 of 5 free-ones. Unlock and itself it-will-save
N5.why: The S29 count says the places are full; "i es desarà" says the item saves itself after unlocking, where "desa’l" would hand the person a second job; exactly 40.

N6.why: The verb S15, M1 and K1 use, so the button and the notice above it say the same thing; 11 characters against 10, but Catalan has no shorter verb for unlock and the l and j are narrow, so it should set in about the width of 10.

N7.s: Ja has omplert els %lld cutlings gratuïts. Desbloqueja Cutling i aquest quedarà desat.
N7.back: Already you-have filled the 5 cutlings free. Unlock Cutling and this-one will-remain saved.
N7.why: Same opening as N1 and N2; on the Share form the item is right there under the notice, so "aquest" points at it, and "quedarà desat" matches N1.

N8.s: Aquest cutling t’espera. Es desarà quan obris i desbloquegis Cutling.
N8.back: This cutling you-waits-for. Itself it-will-save when you-open and you-unlock Cutling.
N8.why: "T’espera" says it was kept warmly without a second save verb next to desar; the two subjunctive verbs share one object, so no clitic can be read as the cutling instead of the app.
